basics.title: The law
basics.text: Selling sex is illegal in Thailand under the Prevention and Suppression of Prostitution Act 1996, even though bars, go-go bars and massage houses work openly. Police usually tolerate adult venues, but raids happen. After a 2023 raid on a bar off Bangla Road (underage workers found), police also arrested foreign customers. Sex shows and nude dancing are charged as obscenity: in 2013 police arrested a Patong bar owner over a sex show, and in Pattaya dancers were arrested in a raid on a lewd show.

basics.title: Age and ID
basics.text: You must be 20 to buy alcohol and to enter bars and clubs. When 04:00 opening started in Dec 2023, Patong venues were told to check ages with the Thai D app to stop fake IDs, and some clubs ask for photo ID at the door. Carry your passport or a copy: if police ask and you do not have it, you may have to show it at a police station within 24 hours. Anyone under 18 is a child under Thai law, with prison terms of years for sexual contact with a child. If someone looks young, leave.

basics.title: Opening hours and alcohol rules
basics.text: Since 16 Dec 2023, licensed entertainment venues in six late zones of Patong may stay open until 04:00. Bars without that licence close at 02:00 or earlier. In Oct 2026 Google lists most Soi Seadragon go-go bars as open until 04:00. Shops sell alcohol from 11:00 to 24:00; the old 14:00-17:00 ban ended (trial from Dec 2025, permanent from late May 2026). No Buddhist holy-day alcohol ban falls between 8 and 26 Jan 2027 (Makha Bucha is about 21 Feb 2027).

basics.title: Touts, bills and cards
basics.text: Never follow a man with a card for a free sex show: touts do not work for the bars, and their cut goes on your bill. In bars your drink bills go in a cup on the table; count them before you pay. Most overcharging in Patong is a wrong count at the end of the night. Pay cash if you can; if you use a card, check the amount on the terminal. A bell in a beer bar is not a toy: ringing it buys a round for the whole bar.

basics.title: Drinks, spiking and theft
basics.text: UK travel advice says drink spiking and drug-assisted sexual assault happen in Thai tourist areas, to men and to women. Watch your drink being made, do not leave it, and be careful with shared buckets. Drinks in Thai bars are often stronger than at home. Bangla Road is packed after 22:00, so keep phones and wallets in front pockets. Lock passports and cash in the villa safe.

basics.title: Police checks, drugs, vapes and kratom
basics.text: Officials do surprise urine tests in Patong venues: 141 Bangla staff in Sept 2024, 48 staff at seven venues in Sept 2025 (6 positive), 220 Bangla workers in Nov 2025 (none positive). In club raids elsewhere in Thailand police test customers too. Drugs bring heavy fines or prison, and in Oct 2026 the government sent bills to parliament to make drug laws tougher. Vapes and e-cigarettes are illegal to own or use; one tourist couple paid a 40,000 THB fine in 2026. Kratom tea is legal for adults: sale to under-18s and pregnant women is banned, mixing it with drugs or cough syrup is illegal, and in Patong it is sold mainly in cannabis shops, not in separate kratom bars.

basics.title: Health
basics.text: Use a condom every time; bring your own or buy them at a pharmacy. If a condom breaks or you think you were exposed to HIV, go to a hospital emergency room and ask for PEP: it must start within 72 hours, the sooner the better, and you take it for 28 days. Drink water between beers, because bar drinks are strong and the night is hot.

basics.title: Getting home and help
basics.text: Take Grab, Bolt or a taxi home, and never ride a scooter after drinking. Patong to Rawai is about 22 km, 40-60 minutes by car at night, and pickups take longer when the clubs close. Emergency numbers: Tourist Police 1155, Police 191, Ambulance 1669. If there is a dispute over a bar bill, stay calm and call the Tourist Police; they often mediate bill disputes on Bangla Road.

basics.title: LGBTQ+ friendliness
basics.text: Thailand is generally safe for LGBTQ+ travellers, and same-sex marriage has been legal since a 2024 law. Phuket's gay bars are in Paradise Complex in Patong, 5 minutes on foot from Bangla Road. Ladyboys (kathoey) are a visible and accepted part of Thai nightlife; be polite and ask before you take a photo of anyone.

basics.title: What the bar words mean
basics.text: Lady drink: a drink you buy for a hostess or dancer who sits with you, usually 200-300 THB; she gets a share, and saying no is normal. Bar fine: a fee paid to the bar when a worker leaves before her shift ends. Chit cup: the cup on your table with your drink bills. Bell: ringing it buys a round for everyone in the bar. Special show: a trick act with props on a go-go stage, free with your drink. Kathoey: the Thai word for trans women, usually called ladyboys in English.

items.name: Bangla Road (Bangla Walking Street)
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Patong Beach Bangla Walking Street' (pin at the beach end of the 400 m street)
items.gmapsQuery: Patong Beach Bangla Walking Street, Bangla Rd, Patong, Phuket
items.openText: Daily. Closed to cars from about 18:00. Small bars close about 02:00, licensed clubs and go-go bars at 04:00.
items.priceText: Street free. Beer 100-180 THB in open beer bars, cocktails 200-350 THB. Club entry 300-500 THB on normal nights.
items.description: Phuket's main nightlife street: 400 m from the beach to Rat-U-Thit Road, closed to cars every evening. Open beer bars with hostesses and bar games, live-music bars and big nightclubs line the road, and the go-go bars are in the side lanes. Ladyboys, touts and cannabis shops are part of the scene.
tips: Busiest 22:00-01:00. Walk it once at about 19:00 to see it calm.
Ignore touts with a card for a free show. They do not work for the bars, and their cut goes on your bill.

Side lanes: Soi Seadragon (go-go bars) and Soi Freedom (beer bars). Old guides also name Soi Gonzo (small beer bars by Aussie Bar) and Soi Crocodile, also called Soi Katoey (ladyboy bars). The Tiger complex is permanently closed.
About 900 m from the Patong villa, a 12-minute walk.
Licensed venues may open until 04:00, so there is no need to rush.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.3 (7,222 reviews), hours 17:00-05:00 most days. Phuket101 (updated 27 Jul 2026): '400-metre strip', 'Walking Street Hours: 6 pm to 4 am for licensed venues. Smaller bars often close around 2 am', beer 100-180 THB, clubs 300-500 THB, 'Touts are not working for bars'. Rawai.com (13 Aug 2026): beer 100-180 THB, cocktails 200-350 THB, the newer Tiger complex 'is now permanently closed'. Wikivoyage: 'Soi Crocodile is also known as Soi Katoey'.

items.name: Soi Seadragon (Soi Sea Dragon)
items.coordSource: Google Maps street 'Soi Seadragon'; matches the go-go bar pins in the lane
items.gmapsQuery: Soi Seadragon, Bangla Rd, Patong, Phuket
items.ratingSource: No Google rating for the lane itself (23 Oct 2026); see the bar cards
items.openText: Daily, bars open about 18:00-20:00; go-go bars until 03:00-04:00
items.priceText: Entry free everywhere. Happy-hour beer near 100 THB early, 100-200 THB later. Lady drink 200-300 THB.
items.description: A short covered lane off the middle of Bangla Road, with two levels, a DJ booth and about 46 bars. Beer bars with hostesses fill the middle, and the go-go bars line the sides: Suzy Wong's, Suzy Wong's 2, Suzy Wong's 3, Harem, Stripper 101 and Diablo. Phuket101 says almost every go-go bar on the island is in this lane.
tips: Prices are on boards outside each bar; read them before you sit.
No photos or video inside the go-go bars.
Couples and women go in too; staff treat them like any other customers (Phuket101).
Diablo A Go Go has a low Google rating: 2.8 from 25 reviews (23 Oct 2026).
In the beer bars hostesses play Connect Four and Jenga for drinks; do not ring the bell.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Phuket101 (updated 12 Aug 2026): 'Soi Seadragon is the one... almost every go go bar on the island is on it', lists Suzy Wong's, Harem, Devil's Playground (Suzy Wong's 2), Suzy Wong's 3 and Diablo; beer 100-200 THB, lady drink 200-300 THB, no entrance fee. Phuket101 Soi Seadragon page (2022): two levels, DJ booth, bell rule. Hotels.com: about 100 m long with about 46 bars. Google Maps bar listings in the lane show 'Open, closes 4 AM' on 23 Oct 2026.

items.name: Soi Freedom (old Soi Eric)
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Tipsy bar Soifreedom Bangla Patong' at 13 Soi Freedom (new, no reviews); approximate pin for the lane
items.gmapsQuery: Soi Freedom, Bangla Rd, Patong, Phuket
items.ratingSource: No Google rating for the lane (23 Oct 2026)
items.openText: Evenings until about 02:00; one listed bar closes at 04:00
items.priceText: Entry free. Beer about 100-180 THB, the normal Bangla beer-bar range.
items.description: A lane off the middle of Bangla Road with about a dozen colourful open beer bars: hostesses, bar games, big TVs and sometimes a live band at the end. Long ago it was Soi Eric, where every bar played the same music.
tips: A 2025 Facebook group post said the beer-bar street was closing (not confirmed). Two 2026 guides still describe it and a new bar appeared on Google in Oct 2026, so check on your first walk.
Same rules as all beer bars: ask the price, keep an eye on the chit cup, do not ring the bell.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Phuket101 Bangla page (updated 27 Jul 2026): 'a friendly and relatively large alley lined with a dozen colourful bars and a great live band at its end (they seem to come and go)', 'better known as the iconic Soi Eric'. Rawai.com (13 Aug 2026): 'Soi Freedom has a compact cluster of colourful bars'. Facebook group post titled 'Patong's Soi Freedom beer-bar street closes' seen only as a search snippet (about 2025), could not open it. Google Maps: 'Tipsy bar Soifreedom', girl bar, 13 Soi Freedom, 'Open, closes 4 AM'.

items.priceText: Entry free. No published prices; ask for the price card.
items.description: An L-shaped street at the south end of Karon with about a dozen old-fashioned beer bars with hostesses. Locals and taxi drivers call it Bangla Plaza, but there is no sign. Phuket101 compares it to an older Bangla Road at a much lower volume.
tips: Karon has no go-go bars.
Small beer bars such as Clapton Bar are also on Patak Road near Karon circle.
About 6 km in a straight line from both villas; Patong to Karon is 15-25 minutes by car (Rawai.com).

items.priceText: Entry free. Cheap beer by Phuket standards; ask for the price card.

tips: Kata has no go-go bars.
About 5 km in a straight line from the Rawai villa, the closest beer-bar street to it after Rawai itself.

items.name: Rawai bars: Wiset Road and lower Soi Sai Yuan
items.coordSource: Centre of a cluster of Google Maps bar listings: Asia Bar (Soi Saiyuan, 7.78889, 98.32996), The Doghouse Bar and Sunshine bar (43 Wiset Rd); Laguna Plaza bars are 1 km south at 178/15 Wiset Rd
items.gmapsQuery: Asia Bar, Soi Saiyuan, Rawai, Phuket
items.ratingSource: Google Maps, 23 Oct 2026 (Asia Bar, the bar with the most reviews here)
items.openText: From afternoon to about 01:00-02:15 (Asia Bar 12:15-02:15, Pleasure Dome Bar 19:00-01:30)
items.priceText: Entry free. Normal expat-bar prices; one reviewer says drinks are cheaper in Chalong.
items.description: Rawai's small bar scene, close to the Rawai villa: open bars along Wiset Road near Rawai Beach and at the lower end of Soi Sai Yuan, used mostly by expats, with hostesses (some of them ladyboys) and sometimes live bands. It is low-key: no go-go bars, and families also sit here early in the evening.
tips: About 1.6 km in a straight line from the Rawai villa.
Laguna Plaza (178/15 Wiset Rd) has Pleasure Dome Bar and Club ZHU, the old Laguna club, Rawai's late-night place (Google: open until 05:00 on Saturday).
A Pleasure Dome Bar review says change for a 1,000 THB note was short; count your change.
For go-go bars and big clubs you need Patong: about 22 km, 40-60 minutes by car (Rawai.com).
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Faszination Suedostasien (page footer 2013-2026): bars along the beach road and Soi Saiyuan with 'Ladys und Ladyboys' and often good bands; The Laguna 'one of the most notorious bars of Rawai'. Rawai.com (Aug 2026): Rawai and Nai Harn have 'a much lower-key nightlife scene built around restaurants, neighbourhood bars'. Google Maps: Asia Bar 4.3 (186), 12:15-02:15; Pleasure Dome Bar 4.7 (67), 19:00-01:30, review 'I ordered 1 chang and gave 1000baht... given 400 in return' and 'kids were able to chase around'; The Laguna Night Club Rawai 4.2 (228), closes 05:00 Sat. lagunarawai.com now shows 'ZHU is a brand new nightclub, bar and dining concept situated in the heart of the Laguna Plaza in Rawai'.

items.name: Suzy Wong's A Go-Go
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Suzy Wong's A Go-Go', 23 off 17-18 Soi Seadragon
items.gmapsQuery: Suzy Wong's A Go-Go, Soi Seadragon, Patong, Phuket
items.priceText: Entry free. Beer 100-200 THB (promo beer about 99 THB in this group's bars), lady drink about 250 THB.
items.description: The oldest and best-known go-go bar in Patong, at the far end of Soi Seadragon, with red Chinese lanterns outside. Dancers on a small stage, loud music, and a running joke: staff hit customers with a noisy foam paddle that does not hurt. Packed most nights, and couples and mixed groups come too.
tips: Prices are on a board outside. Phuket101 advises beer or a spirit on the rocks rather than mixed drinks.
No photos inside.
Busy from about 22:00.
The same company runs Suzy Wong's 2 and 3, Harem, Stripper 101, Rock Hard's Crazy Girls and Madam Wong.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.8 (3,095), 'Adult entertainment club', open, closes 04:00. suzywongs.com: group hours 'Monday to Sunday, 8:00 PM to 4:00 AM' and lists Suzy Wong's, Harem, Stripper 101, Suzy Wong's 2, Rock Hard's Crazy Girls, Suzy Wong's 3, Madam Wong. items.coordSource: Google Maps listing for Suzy Wong's 2 (Devil's Playground), 23/4-5 Soi Seadragon

items.priceText: Entry free. Group prices: promo beer about 99 THB, beer up to 200 THB later, lady drink about 250 THB.
items.description: A long-running go-go bar at the entrance of Soi Seadragon, built to look like a devil's cave but well lit, so you can see the stage. It is now signed as Suzy Wong's 2 and belongs to the same group.
tips: Closes an hour earlier than its sister bars (03:00 on Google).
Good first stop: it is right at the start of the lane.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.9 (1,487), hours 19:30-03:00 every day. items.name: Suzy Wong's 3
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Suzy Wongs 3', 21/3-4 Soi Seadragon
items.gmapsQuery: Suzy Wongs 3, Soi Seadragon, Patong, Phuket
items.priceText: Entry free. Beer from about 90-100 THB on promotion, up to 200 THB later; lady drink about 250 THB.
items.description: The most decorated of the Suzy Wong's bars, at the start of Soi Seadragon in the space that was Exotica. Chinese theme with terracotta warrior statues at the door, DJ music and dancers on stage. The bill comes with each drink, so there are no surprises at the end.
tips: The terracotta warriors at the door are the meeting point most people use.
A Google review summary says staff push you to keep ordering drinks; order at your own pace.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.9 (2,124), 20:00-04:00 daily, review summary 'The staff are friendly, though they do encourage you to keep ordering drinks'. Phuket101 (26 Jan 2025): 'used to be Exotica', 'terracotta Chinese warriors standing guard at the entrance', 'The beer starts at 90 baht', 'Waitresses always bring your bill with your bottle'.

items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Harem Club Phuket', 21/2-8 Soi Seadragon
items.gmapsQuery: Harem Club Phuket, Soi Seadragon, Patong, Phuket
items.priceText: Entry free. Promo beer 99 THB, lady drink about 250 THB.
items.description: A large, upmarket go-go bar in Soi Seadragon with red velvet walls and sofas, two main stages and a DJ. Upstairs, Harem KTV has private karaoke rooms. The room fills up after 23:00.
tips: About 120 m into the lane from the Jungceylon end, past Suzy Wong's 3 and opposite Suzy Wong's 2.
Come after 23:00 for the full room.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.9 (3,700), 20:00-04:00 daily, 'Located in: SD bar', website suzywongs.com. items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Rock Hard's Crazy Girls', 53 Bangla Rd, upstairs, in Paradise Inn

items.priceText: Entry free. Each drink comes with its bill; prices like the other bars of the Suzy Wong's group.
items.description: One of Phuket's first go-go bars, upstairs above an open bar at the top end of Bangla Road near Jungceylon, and the only go-go bar on the main road. It plays rock from the 1980s and 1990s instead of dance pop, and it is larger than most.
tips: Easy to miss: look up for the sign and the stairs.
Good for groups who prefer rock music to EDM.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.8 (812), 'Lounge bar', '53 ชั้น 2 Bangla Rd' (upstairs), 20:00-04:00 daily, same phone as Suzy Wong's group. items.name: Stripper 101
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Stripper 101', Soi Seadragon
items.gmapsQuery: Stripper 101, Soi Seadragon, Patong, Phuket
items.priceText: Entry free. Reviewers mention 'cheap prices'; group prices apply (promo beer about 99 THB, lady drink about 250 THB).
items.description: A newer bar of the Suzy Wong's group in Soi Seadragon. Google lists it as a lounge bar, but reviewers describe a go-go bar with dancers on stage. Some reviews mention nude dancing; Thai police treat that as obscenity, so the show can change after police checks.
tips: One review complains about a rude worker; the review summary also says 'no scam'.
Normal go-go rules: no photos, count your chits before you pay.

items.name: Simon Cabaret
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Simon Cabaret Phuket', 8 Sirirat Rd (plus code V7HR+GV)
items.gmapsQuery: Simon Cabaret Phuket, 8 Sirirat Rd, Patong, Phuket
items.priceText: Regular seat 800 THB, VIP seat 1,000 THB (2026). Photo with performers after the show: 100 THB tip each.
items.description: Phuket's big ladyboy (kathoey) cabaret, open since 1991 in a 600-seat theatre at the south end of Patong. About 70 minutes of lip-sync song and dance numbers in large costumes, with songs from many countries; no plot and no nudity. It is not adults-only: families and tour groups come too.
tips: Book ahead in high season; reseller sites often sell below the box-office price.
No photos during the show. After it, performers line up outside and expect a 100 THB tip per photo (sign at the venue).
About 1.1 km from the Patong villa.
The other big shows are gone: Aphrodite Cabaret (Kathu) is permanently closed on Google, and Athena Cabaret (Phuket Town) was 'not operating' in March 2026.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. items.name: Wake Up Club (天皇秀) adult show
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing '天皇秀WAKE UP CLUB' (plus code V8X2+2FM). One Trip.com listing instead says the show is on the first floor of the Illuzion building on Bangla Road, so check the address on your ticket

tips: Google review snippets (Oct 2026): 'the price is pretty high and they don't allow thai', 'Please save your money and your dignity'.
A reseller listing warns the venue may refuse online tickets and charge the door price; check before you pay.
18+ only. About 1.3 km from the Patong villa.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 3.8 (398), night club, hours 19:00-23:00 daily, review topics 'ping pong show 7', 'adult entertainment 11', 'ladyboy show 2'; snippets quoted above and 'A lot of people, mostly Chinese invited to stage'. Trip.com 84082342: 'The Wake Up Club Adult Show Ticket Phuket', shows 19:00, 20:30, 22:00, about 90 minutes, one free drink, venue given as 'Illuzion Phuket, on the first floor'. items.name: Tout-led 'ping pong' shows off Bangla Road
items.coordSource: No fixed venue: touts work along Bangla Road and lead people to upstairs rooms nearby. Pin is the middle of Bangla Road
items.gmapsQuery: Bangla Road, Patong, Phuket
items.ratingSource: No listing; reviews are on the Bangla Road page of TripAdvisor
items.openText: Evenings, touts on Bangla Road from about 20:00
items.priceText: 'Free entry', then drinks of 700-1,000 THB each or a minimum of 1,000 THB per person; reports of bills of 2,000-5,000 THB and more.
items.description: Men on Bangla Road show a laminated card for a 'free' sex show and walk you upstairs to a room off the street. Entry is free, but the money is taken through very expensive drinks, minimums, repeated tip requests and the tout's cut. This is the best-known bill scam in Patong.
tips: Phuket101 (Aug 2026): 'Touts don't work for the bars.' If you still go, agree the total price out loud before you sit down.
TripAdvisor reviewers report 700 THB and 900 THB for one beer, extra tips asked during the show, and long waits before it starts.
Some go-go bars run the same kind of 'special show' at no extra charge beyond your drink (Phuket101).
If a bill dispute starts, stay calm and call the Tourist Police on 1155.

links.label: Phuket101: the special show and the one a tout sells you

items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Phuket101 (12 Aug 2026): tout shows a laminated card, promises free entrance, walks you upstairs; 'whatever the tout earns lands on your bill afterwards'; inside go-go bars the special show 'costs nothing extra'. Viridian Phuket (2026 guide): '1,000 THB per person drink minimum' once seated. Phuket Escape (2026): bills of '2,000, 5,000 THB, sometimes more'. TripAdvisor: Oct 2018 review, drinks 900 THB; review r641382606, '700baht for a beer'; Q&A answers: drinks about ten times normal prices, repeated tip requests. Older reviews, but 2026 guides confirm the scam continues.

items.name: Zenithy Gentlemen's Club
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Zenithy Gentlemen's Club Phuket', 29/1-2 Bangla Rd
items.gmapsQuery: Zenithy Gentlemen's Club Phuket, 29/1-2 Bangla Rd, Patong, Phuket
items.priceText: Silver VIP package for up to 4 guests 10,000 THB (1 premium spirit, 6 mixers, 1 Prosecco). One reviewer calls beer prices 'really good'; ask for the menu.
items.description: A Western-style gentlemen's club on Bangla Road with pole and stage dancers, VIP seating and drink packages, including bachelor-party packages with hotel transport. Tables can be booked online.
tips: A few Google reviews complain of being overcharged; ask the price of each drink and check the bill.
Good for a group booking: packages cover up to 10 guests.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.7 (540), night club, 21:00-04:00 daily, 'Reserve a table', review topics 'pole dancing', 'dancers'; snippets 'the pricing for the beers was really good' and 'Very bad service by staff or crews too much robbery from customers'. zenithyphuket.com (footer 2026): 'Silver VIP Package For up to 4 Guests... Includes 1 x Premium Spirit with 6 mixers & 1 x Prosecco ฿ 10000', bachelor package with 'Round-trip VIP transportation', address 29/1-2 Bangla Rd.

items.name: Moulin Rouge Phuket
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Moulin Rouge Phuket', 5 Bangla Rd
items.gmapsQuery: Moulin Rouge Phuket, 5 Bangla Rd, Patong, Phuket
items.priceText: Entry conditions and any minimum spend are given on WhatsApp (venue site). Phuket101 says drinks cost more than the usual 180-200 THB go-go price.
items.description: An adults-only show club near the beach end of Bangla Road, with pole dancers on a stage and on the tables. Phuket101 calls it 'a Russian Go Go'; the venue site calls it a gentlemen's club and adult cabaret. Guests must be 20+ with photo ID.
tips: Phuket101 (Jul 2026): 'more expensive than usual and not too friendly'. Ask prices before you order.
A reviewer: 'They are professional pole dancers, you get what you pay for.'
Ask the staff before you take any photo.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.2 (390), 21:00-04:00 daily, snippets 'pole dancers dancing on all tables' and 'THEY ARE PROFESSIONAL POLE DANCERS, YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR'. phuketmoulinrouge.com: 'Open daily, 21:00-04:00', 'Admission is for guests aged 20 and over. Bring valid photo identification', 'an adults-only gentlemen's club and live-performance venue', minimum spend by WhatsApp. Phuket101 (27 Jul 2026): 'Moulin Rouge, a Russian Go Go (yes), which is more expensive than usual and not too friendly'.

items.name: Christin Massage
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Christin Massage', 206 Soi Rat Uthit 200 Pi 2 (plus code V7RW+6H)
items.gmapsQuery: Christin Massage, 206 Soi Rat Uthit 200 Pi 2, Patong, Phuket
items.priceText: Beer in the lobby about 100 THB (review). Service prices are not listed here.
items.description: The best-known 'soapy' massage house on Phuket and the only large one in Patong, a short walk from Bangla Road. Upstairs is a lobby with a glass-fronted room where the masseuses wait with number badges, and the private rooms have bathtubs. It is an adult venue of the kind that operates openly in Thailand, although selling sex is illegal.
tips: Low rating (3.4): recent reviews complain of high prices, sessions shorter than promised and unfriendly staff.
You can sit, have a beer and leave without buying anything else (Thailand Redcat).
Phuket Town has a cluster of smaller places on Phoonpon Road; reviews there report money taken from wallets.
About 500 m from the Patong villa.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 3.4 (238), 'Soapy massage', 13:00-24:00 daily; snippets 'Can walk up stairs and have a beer $100 thb', 'Walked out wasted money'; newest reviews (2-3 weeks old): 'claimed it would last 75 minutes, but it only lasted 45 minutes', 'staff behaves in a very intimidating/unfriendly manner'. Thailand Redcat (updated 19 Jun 2026): 'the most famous soapy massage parlor in Phuket', 'the only massage parlor of this type in... Patong', lobby with a 'big fishbowl', you can 'sit down first and order a beer'. Wanderlog: 'jacuzzi-equipped room'. Angel Massage (Phoonpon Rd, Phuket Town) Google 4.0 (157), snippet 'stole money from my wallet'.

items.name: Paradise Complex (Soi Paradise)
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Soi Paradise (Paradise complex)', 125/10-11 Rat Uthit Song Roi Pi Rd
items.gmapsQuery: Soi Paradise (Paradise complex), Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee Rd, Patong, Phuket
items.openText: Bars open about 20:00-21:00, shows from about 22:30, close 02:00-04:00
items.priceText: Entry free; buy at least one drink. Google lists 200-1,000 THB per person for Zag Club and Cruise Club.
items.description: Phuket's gay nightlife street for more than 20 years: a short pedestrian lane below the Royal Paradise Hotel, 5 minutes on foot from Bangla Road. Gay bars, male go-go dancers, drag and ladyboy cabaret (many shows free, some on the street), massage shops and restaurants. Anyone can come; the crowd mixes tourists, local guys, expats and working men.
tips: Come at 22:30 or later; earlier the bars are empty.
Zag Club's street show at about 23:30 can be watched free from any nearby terrace.
Some bars push you to buy drinks for staff; a polite no is enough.
Bars change often: Boat Bar is permanently closed on Google, and sources disagree on whether Tangmo and My Way still run.
Phuket Pride is in June, not during your trip. About 1.1 km from the Patong villa.

links.label: The Gay Passport: gay bars Phuket

items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Phuket101 (updated 14 Apr 2026): 'centre of Phuket's gay nightlife for more than two decades', 'about a 5-minute walk from Bangla Road', 'Entry is free, but you are expected to buy at least one drink', street shows about 11:30 pm, lists Zag Club, Tangmo, i Bar, My Way Cabaret, Cruise Club, OK Karaoke. Google Maps: 4.2 (89), closes 03:00, snippet 'The performances started at 10.30 pm'; Boat Gay Bar & Cabaret 'Permanently closed'; My Way (143/6) 'Permanently closed'; no listing found for Tangmo. Nomadic Boys: 'the iconic Tangmo Club closed its doors for good just after COVID'.

items.name: Zag Club
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Zag Club', 123/6 Rat Uthit Song Roi Pi Rd
items.gmapsQuery: Zag Club, 123/6 Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee Rd, Patong, Phuket
items.priceText: Entry free. Happy hour 20:00-22:00. Google: 200-1,000 THB per person.
items.description: The biggest and busiest gay club in Paradise Complex, with a street terrace, a main bar and lounge with a dance floor, and a VIP room. Male go-go dancers and drag shows run most nights, and the street show starts at about 23:30.
tips: The terrace fills from about 22:00, then the crowd moves inside.
Mainstream pop music; no dress code.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 3.9 (421), gay bar, 20:00-04:00 every day, 200-1,000 THB per person, snippet 'Highly recommended if you fancy a fun, queer night out in Patong'. Phuket101 (14 Apr 2026): 'the largest and most popular venue', three zones, 'street shows start around 11:30 pm', 'Open 8 pm to 4 am with happy hour from 8-10 pm'. The Gay Passport: no dress code, crowd of tourists, locals and money boys.

items.name: Cruise Club
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Cruise Club Patong', 123/12 Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee Rd (plus code V8W2+72)
items.gmapsQuery: Cruise Club Patong, 123/12 Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee Rd, Patong, Phuket
items.openText: Mainly Friday and Saturday nights; Google shows open until 03:00
items.priceText: Entry free. Google: 200-1,000 THB per person.
items.description: A gay bar in Paradise Complex known for its drag shows, which some visitors rate higher than Zag's. It moved to a new spot at the same address as the closed Boat Bar.
tips: Busy on Friday and Saturday, smaller and quieter on other nights.
Reviewers praise the waiters and say drinks are not diluted.

Google Maps: 4.6 (118), gay bar, '200-1,000 THB per person', 'Open, closes 3 AM' on Friday, snippets 'Great new location with a great show and staff', 'Drinks are decent and not diluted'. Phuket101 (14 Apr 2026): 'operates on Friday and Saturday nights and puts on drag shows that some visitors rate higher than Zag's'. Boat Gay Bar & Cabaret, also 123/12, is 'Permanently closed' on Google.

items.name: Patong Paragon Gun Shooting Range
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Patong Paragon Gun Shooting Range', 70 Bangla Rd (plus code V7VX+J5)
items.gmapsQuery: Patong Paragon Gun Shooting Range, 70 Bangla Rd, Patong, Phuket
items.priceText: From 2,300 THB (Ontway booking page).
items.description: A real-gun shooting range in a building on Bangla Road, so you can shoot pistols before a night out. Staff supervise each round. Why 18+: under Thai law people under 20 may not handle firearms at a range, and you need photo ID.
tips: Shoot first, drink later: ranges refuse anyone who has been drinking.
Reviewers like the choice of guns; one felt rushed to finish the round.
About 900 m from the Patong villa.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.6 (339), 10:30-23:30 daily, website ontway.com, snippets 'Good place, wide selection' and 'Also felt rushed, urged to quickly finish the round'. Ontway home page: 'Patong Walking Street Shooting Experience, Professional Real Gun Shooting at Patong Walking Street, Regular price From 2,300.00 ฿'. Age rule from Phuket Shooters range rules: 'Thai law prohibits the use or handling of firearms by persons under 20 years of age'.

items.name: Phuket Shooters Shooting Range
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Phuket Shooters Shooting Range', 33/54 Soi Palai, Chalong (plus code R9R4+JG)
items.gmapsQuery: Phuket Shooters Shooting Range, Soi Palai, Chalong, Phuket
items.priceText: 10 bullets: 1,050 THB (.22), 1,250 THB (9mm, .38, .45), 1,450 THB (shotgun). Packages 3,100-4,950 THB.
items.description: A modern range opened in October 2024 near the Phuket Dolphin show in Chalong: a 25 m range with 12 bays and more than 30 guns (.22, .38, .45, 9mm and shotguns), plus archery, crossbows and BB guns. Instructors are accredited by Thailand's practical shooting association. Why 18+: real guns only for 20+ under Thai law, with photo ID.
tips: Bring your passport or driving licence; the range records every shooter for the police.
No alcohol or drugs before shooting.
No booking needed, but you can book a time slot.
About 5 km in a straight line from the Rawai villa.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Official site (footer 2025): 'opened in October 2024', 'open... 7 days a week from 9am to 6pm', '25m range has 12 shooting bays', 'over 30 different firearms', 'Thai law prohibits the use of firearms by under 20 year olds'. Prices page: 9mm/.45/.38 10 bullets 1,250 THB, .22 1,050 THB, shotgun 1,450 THB, packages 3,100 to 4,950 THB. Range rules: photo ID required, no alcohol or drugs. Google Maps: 4.8 (147), 09:00-18:00 daily.

items.name: Phuket Shooting Range (Patak Road)
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Phuket Shooting Range', 82/35 Moo 4 Patak Rd, Rawai (plus code R8CM+Q5)
items.gmapsQuery: Phuket Shooting Range, Patak Rd, Rawai, Phuket
items.description: A large shooting range on Patak Road between Kata and Chalong, about 2.4 km from the Rawai villa: pistols, rifles and shotguns, with clay shooting, paintball, airsoft and go-karts on the same site. Why 18+: real guns are for 20+ under Thai law, so bring photo ID.
tips: The website lists a minimum height of 135 cm but no age; ask before you bring anyone young.
Reviewers say 'a bit overpriced' and mention cash only; bring cash.
The closest real-gun range to the Rawai villa.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.4 (717), 09:00-18:00 daily, website phuketshooting.com, review topics 'cash only 4', snippets 'Friendly staff, but a bit overpriced'. phuketshooting.com: 10 bullets .45, 9mm, .38 1,280 THB, .22 1,090 THB, shotgun 1,300 THB, 'Minimum height 135 cm', links to clay shooting, paintball, airsoft, archery and racing karts. The 20+ firearm rule is from the Phuket Shooters range rules, not this range's site.

items.name: Xventure Shooting Range Association
items.coordSource: Google Maps listing 'Xventure Shooting Range Association' (plus code R8JM+JCG), Chalong
items.gmapsQuery: Xventure Shooting Range Association, Chalong, Phuket
items.priceText: No published prices; reviewers say both 'a bit pricey' and 'good prices'. Ask before you shoot.
items.description: A shooting sports club in Chalong, 3.5 km from the Rawai villa, with a wide choice of guns and instructors. It has the highest Google rating of the ranges we checked near Rawai. Why 18+: real guns are for 20+ under Thai law, so bring photo ID.
tips: Reviewers praise the professional set-up, clean area and kind staff.
Daytime only: it closes at 17:30.
